test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

The strike has been called off by the workers.

options.text: The workers are calling off the strike.
The workers have called off the strike.
The strike has called off the workers.
The workers had called off the strike.

solution:
The correct answer is '**The workers have called off the strike**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given above sentence is in a 'passive voice form', hence we need to convert it into an 'active voice form'
 
• We need to follow these instructions while changing the voice of the **present perfect tense**.
 
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice and '**The strike**' is the subject and '**the workers**' is the object.
 
• When we convert this sentence into active voice, the subject 'The strike' of the passive voice becomes the object, the object 'the workers' becomes the subject.
 
• Remove the word 'been' and 'by' because these words are not used in the active form of the past perfect tense.
 
• The active formet **"has/have+ V3"** should be used.
 
 
 
• Let's have a look at the structural form of the given rule:
 
 
• **​Subject + has/have+ v3+ object. (active voice)**
 
• **Object+ has/have+ been+ V3+ by + subject. (passive voice)****​**
 
 
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the present perfect tense.
 
• **Example: **
 
 
• **​***She has been challenged by Nitesh. (passive voice)*
 
• *Nitesh has challenged her. (active voice)**​*
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that ‘The workers have called off the strike’ is the correct active form of the given sentence.
